name: ascension-game
description: Living-room client and room server for Project Ascension

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,client -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @ascension/shared" "npm run dev -w @ascension/server" "npm run dev -w @ascension/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ascension/shared && npm run build -w @ascension/server && npm run build -w @ascension/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ascension/shared && npm run build -w @ascension/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ascension/server && npm run typecheck -w @ascension/client
scripts.test: npm run build -w @ascension/shared && npm run test -w @ascension/server
scripts.start: npm run build -w @ascension/shared && npm run start -w @ascension/server
